spans.s:
नि-यत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Checked, re-
strained; fixed.
n. Crude matter.
adv. Constantly.

नियत-मानस (सः-सा-सं)
a. Of sub-
dued mind, or temper.

नियता_त्मन् (त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
a. Idem.

नियता_हार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Abstemious.

नियति (तिः) 2.
f. Destiny, luck;
religious duty.
f. (तो)
Durgā.

नियते_न्द्रिय (यः) 1.
m. A sage, or man
of subdued passions.

नि-यन्तव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That should
be restrained, or subdued.

नि-यन्तृ (न्ता) 4.
m. A charioteer; a
ruler; punisher.
a. Ruling.

नि-यन्त्रित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Restrained.

नि-यम (मः) 1.
m. Agreement, co-
venant; religious observance;
certainty; precept; practice.

नि-यमन (नं) 1.
n. Binding; re-
straining; a precept.

नी-यमान (नः-ना-नं)
p. Being taken.

नियम-पर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Observing rules.

नि-यमित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Bound; check-
ed; governed; prescribed.

नियातन (नं) 1.
n. Causing to fall.

नि-यामक (कः) 1.
m. A boatman, a
sailor, a pilot.
a. Guiding.

नि-युञ्जान (नः-ना-नं)
p. Appointing.

नियुत (तः-तं) 1.
m. n. Ten millions.

नियुत्सपिस् (पोः) 5.
f.
Durgā.

नि-युद्ध (द्धं) 1.
n. Close fight.

नि-योक्तव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That may
be appointed or authorised.

नि-योग (गः) 1.
m. An order; appoint-
ment; occupation; effort.

नियोग-प्रयोजन (नं) 1.
n. Object of
appointment; authorized act.

नियोग-विधि (धिः) 2.
m. Form of ap-
pointing to any work.

नियोगा-र्थ (र्थः) 1.
m. Object of ap-
pointing to any work.

नि-योगिन् (गी-गिनी-गि)
a. Engaged
in; ordering.
m. A deputy.

नि-योग्य (ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
a. Fit to be ap-
pointed.
m. A master.

नि-योजन (नं) 1.
n. Ordering; uni-
ting; impelling.

नि-योजित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Appointed
to; urged to; joined, suited to.

नि-योजनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may
be appointed to any work.

नि-योज्य (ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
a. Idem; servant.

नि-योद्धृ (द्धा) 4.
m. A wrestler; a cock.
